title: Defake-o3: From Speculative Rationales to Verifiable Evidence for Explainable AIGI Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.16259v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rapid progress of image generation models calls for AI-generated image (AIGI) detectors that are not only accurate but also explainable and reliable. While MLLM-based detectors can provide natural language explanations, existing methods often generate speculative rationales: they rely on vague or hallucinated artifacts, miss subtle localized flaws from the latest generators, and fail to provide evidence that can be visually verified. We present Defake-o3, an explainable AIGI detector that moves from speculative rationales to verifiable evidence. It combines interactive visual search with verifier-guided evidence alignment: the model iteratively zooms into suspicious regions to inspect fine-grained details, while an Evidence Verifier, trained from human verification annotations, provides reinforcement learning rewards that favor grounded evidence and penalize baseless claims. translated_abstract: 图像生成模型的快速进步要求AI生成图像（AIGI）检测器不仅准确，还要具有可解释性和可靠性。虽然基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的检测器能够提供自然语言解释，但现有方法往往生成推测性理由：它们依赖模糊或幻觉性的伪影，错过最新生成器产生的细微局部缺陷，并且无法提供可视觉验证的证据。我们提出了Defake-o3，一种从推测性理由转向可验证证据的可解释AIGI检测器。它结合了交互式视觉搜索与验证器引导的证据对齐：模型迭代地放大可疑区域以检查细粒度细节，同时一个由人类验证注释训练的证据验证器提供强化学习奖励，该奖励支持有根据的证据并惩罚无根据的声明。为支持这一目标，我们构建了GroundFake，一个数据集...
tldr: Defake-o3通过交互式视觉搜索和证据验证器驱动的强化学习，将AIGI检测从推测性理由提升为可视觉验证的证据，从而增强可解释性和可靠性。
en_tdlr: Defake-o3 advances AIGI detection from speculative rationales to visually verifiable evidence via interactive visual search and verifier-guided reinforcement learning, enhancing explainability and reliability.
